{"people":[{"name":"Jordan","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"Halima","role":"COO, final decision maker","side":"customer"},{"name":"Ben","role":"CTO, wanted us","side":"customer"},{"name":"CEO (unnamed)","role":"CEO, saw the failure screenshots on social","side":"customer"},{"name":"Named solutions engineer (unnamed)","role":"competitor solutions engineer in the room","side":"competitor"},{"name":"Account lead (unnamed)","role":"competitor account lead in the room","side":"competitor"},{"name":"PMM","role":"interviewer","side":"other"}],
"competitors":[],
"incumbent":"The customer's existing payments provider, unnamed (support was a ticket form)",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Big arena tour, tickets went live at 10am on a Friday, and payments started failing about four minutes in.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The trigger was a payments failure at a big on-sale."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their provider's support was a ticket form. They got a reply after the on-sale was over.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"The incumbent's support failed during the outage, which sets up the later 'who' theme."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"The CEO was getting screenshots on social.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The failure became visible to the CEO and the public."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"So Monday morning the COO, Halima, says they're replacing payments before the spring on-sales.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"The deadline was spring on-sales, and Halima drove the replacement."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Ben, their CTO, said twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Ben reports two earlier payment failures during on-sales."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"But this was the first time the CEO saw it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Executive visibility, not the failure itself, triggered the evaluation."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Two hundred and fifty K ACV.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Deal size."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"Their volume spikes hard around big on-sales.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Spiky volume around big on-sales."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Halima. Ben wanted us.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Halima decided, and the CTO favored us."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"He called me before the official email went out","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Ben told the rep about the loss before the official email."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"it was Halima's call and she made it in one meeting.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ben","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"The decision was made by Halima in a single meeting."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"They showed up with the people who'd actually be on the account.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Relayed from Ben: the competitor brought the actual account team."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"A named solutions engineer and an account lead, in the room.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Named people were present in the competitor's pitch."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"there'd be a shared channel and someone on call for every major on-sale","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"The competitor's promise as reported by Ben."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"I think they over-promised. I don't think anybody staffs every on-sale. But I don't know that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"The rep's own unverified theory about the competitor, with a hedge."},
{"id":"E16","turn":12,"excerpt":"Everything turned into 'who.'","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","message"],"note":"After the competitor meeting, the customer's questions shifted to who."},
{"id":"E17","turn":12,"excerpt":"Who do I call at 10 on a Friday. Who's my person. What's the escalation path if that person's on holiday.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","gaps"],"note":"The customer's new questions were about named people and escalation."},
{"id":"E18","turn":12,"excerpt":"Before that meeting it was throughput, queueing, bots. After, it was names.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"The customer's questions moved from technical topics to names."},
{"id":"E19","turn":14,"excerpt":"Reaction: the technical story.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The technical story got a reaction."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"Ben's team ran a load test in the sandbox and it went great.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The load test was a technical win with Ben's team."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"The bot and fraud tooling got a good reaction too.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Bot and fraud tooling resonated."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence: when Halima asked, 'who's my person,' and I walked her through the support plans. The tiers, the response times.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"The rep answered a who question with support tiers, which got silence."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"so it's a queue with a faster timer.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language","decided"],"note":"Halima's verdict on our support plans."},
{"id":"E24","turn":16,"excerpt":"Right before it we were the favourite.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"The rep's read that we led until Halima's remark."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"Ben had basically told his team to start planning the integration.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Ben's team was preparing to integrate, hedged with 'basically'."},
{"id":"E26","turn":18,"excerpt":"She wanted to see, on paper, what we do on an on-sale morning.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Halima asked for a written on-sale plan."},
{"id":"E27","turn":18,"excerpt":"We don't have that as a thing.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"We have no on-sale plan asset."},
{"id":"E28","turn":18,"excerpt":"I could have built something with our solutions engineer, and I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The rep admits not building a plan that was feasible."},
{"id":"E29","turn":20,"excerpt":"I thought the load test had won it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"The rep's assumption for why no plan was built."},
{"id":"E30","turn":20,"excerpt":"I had logos. I didn't have a person.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No ticketing reference who could speak personally."},
{"id":"E31","turn":22,"excerpt":"Ben presented them to her.","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"Halima got the load test results via Ben, not from the rep."},
{"id":"E32","turn":22,"excerpt":"good.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Halima's muted reaction to the load test."},
{"id":"E33","turn":24,"excerpt":"A name, not a queue.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"The customer's own framing of the need."},
{"id":"E34","turn":24,"excerpt":"Someone who picks up.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"The customer wants a person who answers."},
{"id":"E35","turn":24,"excerpt":"I don't buy uptime, I buy what happens when it's down.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decided","message"],"note":"Halima's buying criterion is response when down, not uptime."},
{"id":"E36","turn":24,"excerpt":"Nobody said 'support.' They said 'who.'","label":"fact","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"The customer never used the word support."},
{"id":"E37","turn":26,"excerpt":"We were the better platform.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","message"],"note":"The rep's self-assessment, which conflicts with the customer's criteria."},
{"id":"E38","turn":26,"excerpt":"Ben would tell you that today.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Jordan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"The rep's claim about what Ben would say, not something Ben said."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E29","E32","E35"],"what":"The rep thought the load test had won it, but Halima's only reaction was 'good' and she said she doesn't buy uptime."},
{"evidence":["E37","E35"],"what":"The rep says we were the better platform, but Halima chose on what happens when it's down, not on the platform."},
{"evidence":["E24","E9","E11"],"what":"The rep says we were the favourite and Ben was planning the integration, but Ben was not the decider and Halima decided in one meeting."},
{"evidence":["E22","E36"],"what":"The rep answered 'who's my person' with support plans, but the customer never used the word support."},
{"evidence":["E15","E14"],"what":"The rep says the competitor over-promised and then admits not knowing, while the competitor's promises came only from Ben."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":10,"what":"The rep never named the competitor and mixed Ben's report with their own speculation, then admitted 'I don't know that'."},
{"question":"Had payments failed during an on-sale before?","turn":4,"what":"The rep deferred to Ben ('said twice') and gave no firsthand detail."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"A name, not a queue / Someone who picks up / who's my person","ours":"support plans, tiers, response times","evidence":["E22","E33","E34","E36"]},
{"theirs":"I don't buy uptime, I buy what happens when it's down","ours":"uptime history, docs, technical story","evidence":["E19","E35"]},
{"theirs":"on-sale morning / on-sale plan","ours":"load test in the sandbox, throughput","evidence":["E20","E26","E18"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E9","E10","E11"],"what":"Lost: Ben said he lost, and Halima decided in one meeting."},
{"evidence":["E4"],"what":"The customer is replacing payments entirely, so the loss looks total rather than partial."},
{"evidence":["E24","E25"],"what":"We led until Halima's 'queue with a faster timer' remark, per the rep."},
{"evidence":["E27","E28"],"what":"Loss tied to not producing an on-sale plan, which the rep says could have been built."}
]}
